info.title: FOSSBilling Extensions API (v2)
info.description: Self-service extension publishing, ownership, moderation, and public browsing. v1 (/extensions/v1) remains available for existing integrations.

spdx_id.description: A current SPDX license identifier (https://spdx.org/licenses/). Omitted for custom or proprietary licenses.

get.summary: List extensions: published catalogue (scope=public), caller's own (scope=mine), or every extension (scope=all, moderator)

schema.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page

parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page
parameters.name: cursor

schema.description: public: published catalogue (anonymous allowed). mine: caller's own extensions. all: every extension (moderator only).

parameters.description: public: published catalogue (anonymous allowed). mine: caller's own extensions. all: every extension (moderator only).
parameters.name: scope

schema.description: All scope only: published, delisted, or unpublished

parameters.description: All scope only: published, delisted, or unpublished
parameters.name: status

schema.description: All scope only: case-insensitive substring match on the extension id

parameters.description: All scope only: case-insensitive substring match on the extension id
parameters.name: q

200.description: Extensions matching the scope: catalogue cards for scope=public, owned rows for scope=mine/all

403.description: Inactive account, non-moderator scope=all, or scope misuse

422.description: Filter or pagination query failed validation

post.summary: Create an extension and submit its first version for review

201.description: Extension created. It holds the id immediately but stays out of the public catalogue until a moderator approves the revision.

403.description: The account is inactive, or the caller has no developer profile to publish under

409.description: The id is taken, ownership changed, or the pending-revision limit was reached

422.description: Body failed validation

get.summary: Get an extension: published content anonymously, full owned record for its owner or a moderator

200.description: Published projection for anonymous/unrelated callers, owned projection for the owner or a moderator

422.description: id param failed validation

put.summary: Submit an edit to an extension the caller owns

202.description: Edit accepted as a pending revision. The published content is unchanged until a moderator approves it.

403.description: The account is inactive, or the caller does not own this extension

409.description: An edit is already awaiting review, or the pending-revision limit was reached

422.description: Body failed validation

delete.summary: Withdraw an extension that has never been published

200.description: Extension and its revisions deleted, and the id released

403.description: The account is inactive, or the caller does not own this extension

409.description: The extension is published and cannot be withdrawn

get.summary: List an extension's revisions, newest first

200.description: Every version proposed for this extension, with its review outcome

403.description: The account is inactive, or the caller neither owns this extension nor moderates

422.description: Pagination query failed validation

put.summary: Synchronize the caller's OIDC identity projection

200.description: Identity projection synchronized

403.description: Identity synchronization requires a trusted assertion

422.description: Identity payload failed validation

Profile updated (full account projection)

post.summary: Request ownership of an unowned developer profile

201.description: Claim created and pending moderator review

422.description: The request failed validation, or the GitHub account type is unsupported

429.description: GitHub verification is temporarily rate limited

post.summary: Withdraw the caller's own pending profile claim
